description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) used to test the 'git unpack-objects' command with large objects, focusing on handling large file objects, memory limitations, and filesystem sync behaviors in a Git repository environment.

methods.name: prepare_dest
methods.description: Initializes a bare Git repository at 'dest.git' and sets its core.bigFileThreshold configuration to the specified size.

methods.name: check_fsync_events
methods.description: Analyzes trace logs from GIT_TRACE2_EVENT to verify fsync-related events match expected patterns.
